newsitem.title: USA: Thermo Electron sets $50 mln repurchase.
newsitem.headline: Thermo Electron sets $50 mln repurchase.

text.p: Thermo Electron Corp said Thursday that it will repurchase up to $50 million of its publicly-held subsidiaries' securities in the open market, or in negotiated transactions.
The company said the repurchase program will end August 14, 1998, and the shares will be used to maintain the required ownership of such subsidiaries for accounting and/or tax consolidation.
Since January 1997, the company has spent about $110 million to repurchase securities under previous authorizations, not including separate repurchases by the subsidiaries themselves.
Thermo Electron makes environmental-monitoring and analysis instruments, papermaking and recycling equipment, biomedical products and is involved in biomass electric power generation.
